title: Open The Lock
description: You have a lock with 4 circular wheels, each with digits 0-9. The lock starts at "0000". You are given a list of deadends (states that block further moves) and a target string. Each move turns one wheel one slot (up or down). Return the minimum moves to reach the target, or -1 if impossible.
